posts.text:
Malaysia's DE Rantau pass: 3-12 months, up to 24 with renewal, for Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan.

Annual income: USD 24,000 for tech freelancers/remote employees; USD 60,000 for non-tech talent.
posts.alt: Malaysia photo and DE Rantau comparison. Minimum annual income: USD 24,000 for tech freelancers or remote employees; USD 60,000 for non-tech talent. Pass lasts 3-12 months, up to 24 with renewal, in Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan. Employees need a foreign employer; freelancers may serve Malaysian clients. Contracts must have started at least 3 months before application. Checked October 20, 2026.

posts.text:
Japan's Digital Nomad visa: 6 months, no extension. Remote workers need JPY 10 million annual income and JPY 10 million medical cover.

The principal-applicant nationality list includes the US; India is not listed.
posts.alt: Japan photo and Digital Nomad visa requirements: at least JPY 10 million annual income; death, injury or illness insurance with at least JPY 10 million for injury or illness treatment. Stay: 6 months, no extension. The principal-applicant nationality list includes the US, but not India; the spouse and child list differs. Checked October 20, 2026.

posts.text:
Costa Rica's remote-worker Estancia lasts 1 year, renewable once.

Show USD 3,000/month from overseas work for the previous year (USD 4,000 with dependants), plus USD 50,000 medical cover for the full stay.
posts.alt: Costa Rica flag and remote-worker Estancia requirements. Overseas monthly income for the previous year: USD 3,000 individual or USD 4,000 with dependants. Medical cover: at least USD 50,000 for the full stay, including each dependant. Stay: 1 year, renewable once; renewal requires at least 80 days physically in Costa Rica. Checked October 20, 2026.

Japan's nomad visa allows 6 months; Thailand's DTV is valid for 5 years, with 180 days per entry.

Compare five remote-work routes. Eligibility depends on your work, finances, nationality and application location.

London also requires permanent-residence proof and police clearance.

2. Malaysia's DE Rantau pass: 3-12 months, up to 24 with renewal, for Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan.

Annual income: USD 24,000 for tech freelancers/remote employees; USD 60,000 for non-tech talent.

3. Japan's Digital Nomad visa: 6 months, no extension. Remote workers need JPY 10 million annual income and JPY 10 million medical cover.

The principal-applicant nationality list includes the US; India is not listed.

4. Costa Rica's remote-worker Estancia lasts 1 year, renewable once.

Show USD 3,000/month from overseas work for the previous year (USD 4,000 with dependants), plus USD 50,000 medical cover for the full stay.

5. Barbados Welcome Stamp: 12 months of remote work for overseas clients or employers. Expected income: at least USD 50,000 over that year.

Fee after approval: USD 2,000 individual or USD 3,000 family.
